title: Changes to our expense approval process
body: We are changing how expenses are approved, effective 1 September 2026. Today every expense over 50 dollars needs a manager signature, and the average reimbursement takes eleven days. Because finance now reconciles card transactions automatically, that second approval no longer tells us anything we do not already know, so we are removing it. This affects everyone who submits expenses on a company card. If you do not hold a company card, nothing changes for you. Card holders: please confirm your default cost centre in the expense tool by 25 August, because the new flow routes on cost centre rather than on reporting line. It takes about two minutes. Questions go to #ask-finance, and Priya on the finance operations team will answer within one business day.
